item.title: Governor Hochul Announces New Study Highlighting New York’s Position as a National Leader in Quantum Technology
item.description: Insider Brief PRESS RELEASE — Governor Kathy Hochul today announced the release of a comprehensive study of New York State’s quantum technology landscape, finding that the Empire State ranks second nationally in quantum-related businesses, research groups and patents.
